name: Zone Area Dashboard
summary: Zone areas grouped by name, category, story, property or classification as cards, a table and charts; highlights groups in Archicad, exports to Excel or CSV.

versions.changelog: The window opens smaller (800 x 700, at most 85 % of the screen), can be made as small as 800 x 520, and its content scrolls when the window is short.
When the Tapir helpers utilities and aclib are not found, it says so and how to fix it, instead of failing with "No module named 'utilities'".

Charts: a donut of the share per group, a bar chart of the area per group, the area per story split by the colour-by value and a treemap of the zones, with legends; a click highlights their zones in Archicad. The Excel export adds the area per story as a sheet.
First version: summary cards, a grouped table, highlight and colour by parameter in Archicad, Excel and CSV export.
